sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: -- 42 of 57 -- Anna Geniushene's silver medal at the 2022 Cliburn competition announced a fascinating, distinctive artist with raw power and deep curiosity. Her program moves from Brahms' searching Ballades through Liszt's hauntingly beautiful Valses Oubliées to Beethoven's monumental Eroica Variations.
body: Anna Geniushene's silver medal at the 2022 Cliburn competition marked the arrival of a fascinating, distinctive artist with raw power, deep curiosity, and an uncanny instinct for music that rewards thoughtful listening. Her program moves from Brahms' dark, searching Ballades through Liszt's hauntingly beautiful Valses Oubliées to Beethoven's monumental Eroica Variations. Come ready to discover an artist—and a program—that lingers purposefully on the mind and spirit.

sections.title: Today's Program
sections.lead: 2022 Cliburn silver medalist. Brahms Ballades Op. 10, Bartk Scherzo, Chopin Variations brillantes Op. 12, Liszt Valses oublies Nos. 1-3, Beethoven Eroica Variations Op. 35.
